def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=grid[r][c]
        if color==bg: continue
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
          pr,pc=r-dr,c-dc
          if 0<=pr<h and 0<=pc<w and grid[pr][pc]==color:
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and out[rr][cc]==bg:
              out[rr][cc]=color
              rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return out

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(
        set(value for row in grid for value in row),
        key=lambda value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid),
    )

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background:
                continue

            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue

                run = [(r, c)]
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue

                r0, c0 = run[0]
                r1, c1 = run[-1]
                extensions = []
                for sr, sc, er, ec in ((-dr, -dc, r0, c0), (dr, dc, r1, c1)):
                    cells = []
                    rr, cc = er + sr, ec + sc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == background:
                        cells.append((rr, cc))
                        rr += sr
                        cc += sc
                    extensions.append(cells)

                # Extend only when exactly one end of the diagonal run is open.
                if bool(extensions[0]) != bool(extensions[1]):
                    for rr, cc in extensions[0] or extensions[1]:
                        out[rr][cc] = color

    return out
'''
